description: This plot illustrates the performance of knowledge probing after editing with different methods on the Llama2 model, with the y-axis representing ACC (%) on a linear scale ranging from 60 to 80 and the x-axis representing Co-occurrence Number on a logarithmic scale spanning from 10^0 to 10^3. Five distinct lines are shown: the black line with circle markers (Base), the brown line with triangle markers (MEND), the blue line with triangle markers (FT), the purple line with diamond markers (MEMIT), and the red line with triangle markers (IKE). The green line with square markers (ROME) is consistently the highest performing method, starting at approximately 75% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1 and rising to about 80% at 1000. The Base model starts at around 65% and shows the lowest performance, remaining relatively flat. The other methods show increasing performance with higher co-occurrence numbers, with MEND, MEMIT, and IKE all reaching around 75% to 77% by the end of the scale.
